name: Advance one real turn and confirm the Government Plaza at the accepted plot

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityDistrictOutcome(); assert(o.stage=='PROGRESS_PENDING' and o.occupied==1 and o.captured==1,'Government Plaza no longer needs a production turn'); return o.stage

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; if not (p and p:IsTurnActive()) then return false end; local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityDistrictOutcome(); return o.turn>o.progressTurn and o.stage=='DISTRICT_BUILT'

steps.code: local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityDistrictOutcome(); assert(o.stage=='DISTRICT_BUILT' and o.targetBuilt and o.turn>o.progressTurn and o.occupied==1 and o.captured==1 and o.capacity==1,'native Government Plaza district or original captive missing'); return 'DISTRICT_BUILT plot='..o.plot..' city='..o.cityID
